Two fixes from an investigation of three CRITICAL alerts: runs 41071146143 and 41120847965, and issue #8470.

## 1. Unblock judge resumed an issue into the same planning block (#8470)

#8470 is a CI-triage issue whose only fix was a CI re-run. Planning stopped with `work is already on the planning ref; nothing to implement`. The unblock judge filed fix-up #8471, and once it merged posted `/answer`. Planning (run 41120847965) then stopped again with the same reason: a resume cannot change what the issue itself needs.

**Change (`scripts/unblock_judge.sh`):** a new `unblock_nothing_to_implement_close` runs at the one point where the judge would post the resume command for a done fix-up. It acts on a standalone issue at stop `blocked` when the newest "Planning blocked" comment from the pipeline login gives that reason. The judge then:
- posts one comment ending in `<!-- ai:unblock-nothing-to-implement:v1 item=<n> fixup=<f> -->` (not posted again when a trusted copy exists),
- adds `ai:closed`,
- closes the issue as completed,
- marks the fix-up wait `done`.

Limits and failure handling:
- Orchestrator items (with a tracking issue) and every other reason resume as before.
- The protected-path handoff and the operator-step hold still run first.
- A failed write keeps the wait open, so the next scan retries.
- No new reads; at most three writes.
- Kill switch `UNBLOCK_NOTHING_TO_IMPLEMENT_CLOSE_ENABLED` (default `true`).
- New log line: `UNBLOCK_JUDGE ... op=nothing_to_implement outcome=closed|skip reason=...`.
